title: Chief of aerospace medicine attached to NASA and the Air Force saw something
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Chief of aerospace medicine attached to NASA and the Air Force saw something, about unspecified at NASA / US Air Force, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I just interviewed a uh uh chief uh of aerospace medicine, you know, one of the top doctors. He was attached to NASA. He was at the the Air Force. He was a senior doctor there. Uh and he saw something.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says he recently interviewed a man who was chief of aerospace medicine, a senior doctor who looks after the health of pilots and astronauts, working with NASA, the US space agency, and with the US Air Force. Michels says this doctor saw something unexplained, and he raises it to show that even highly placed people report such things.
